title.narrative: Support Services for the USAID Early Reading Project in Haiti

description.narrative:
The Early Reading Project by USAID aims to assist the Haitian Ministry of Education in improving early grade reading and writing outcomes in Haitian Creole and French for children in the first four grades.

The high illiteracy rate in Haiti remains a key obstacle to the country’s social and economic development. Research shows that a successful outcome in learning in any subject area, such as mathematics and science, is strongly linked to well-developed reading competencies. Learning to read early is essential to a positive start for children’s academic and professional success. Education is also one of the highest priorities of the Government of Haiti, and the Haitian Ministry of Education considers learning to read and write a “national cause.” In close collaboration with other donors and in line with both the Ministry of Education and USAID’s objectives, the Early Reading Project takes a holistic approach to improve Haitian education and literacy. 

UNOPS offers project support services through (1) the procurement of printing services for study materials for the students, as well as providing their distribution to schools. (2) Creating a school mapping, with a database which includes civic addresses, GPS locations, classroom levels and other pertinent information on each school, as well as a provision of capacity building and internet access for the project. (3)And finally, through maintenance of service vehicles, where strategic approach is taken to support the Ministry of Education’s project operation.
